question: Which runes give the most early pressure, mid-game skirmish power and skill ceiling? Win rate is context only.

wiki.note: Ranged values. Values shown as 'a to b' scale with level 1 to 18; the model treats them as linear in level, which is an approximation.

enemy.label: a typical enemy ADC, no HP or resist items

onhit.label: On-hit, 2 items + boots
onhit.items: Blade of the Ruined King, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Berserker's Greaves

ap.label: AP, 2 items + boots
ap.items: Dusk and Dawn, Nashor's Tooth, Sorcerer's Shoes

builds.note: Item stats from Data Dragon 16.22.1. Item passives (Ruined King, Rageblade, Nashor's on-hit, Dusk and Dawn) are left out on purpose: they add damage that every keystone gets, so the gaps between keystones stay about the same.

Lethal Tempo.wiki: Each attack on a champion: +4.8% attack speed for 6 s, up to 6 stacks (28.8%). At 6 stacks attacks fire a bolt: 6 to 21.66 adaptive damage, +1% per 1% bonus attack speed.

Press the Attack.wiki: 3 attacks on one champion within 4 s: 40 to 174 adaptive damage, then 8% increased damage to them until 5 s out of combat. Cooldown 6 s.

Fleet Footwork.wiki: Moving and attacking build charges. At 100 the next attack heals 9 to 109.64 (+6% bonus AD, +3% AP) and gives 15% move speed for 1 s. No damage.

Conqueror.wiki: Ranged: 1 stack per attack, 2 per ability (once per 4 s per cast), 12 max. Each stack: 1.08 to 2.56 AD or 1.8 to 4.26 AP. At 12 stacks heal 5% of damage dealt.

Hail of Blades.wiki: Reworked 26.21/26.22. Ranged: 2 empowered attacks with +60% attack speed (can pass the cap), each dealing 2 to 22.12 (+12% bonus AD, +10% AP) true damage. Extra stacks only from attack resets (Kog has none). Cooldown 10 s.

Electrocute.wiki: 3 separate hits on a champion within 3 s: 70 to 260 (+10% bonus AD, +5% AP) adaptive damage. Cooldown 20 s.

Dark Harvest.wiki: Hit a champion below 50% HP: 30 (+11 per soul, +10% bonus AD, +5% AP) adaptive damage. Cooldown 35 s, 1 s after a takedown.

First Strike.wiki: Hit a champion before they hit you: 3 s of +7% bonus true damage, then gold equal to 35% of that bonus damage. Cooldown 25 to 15 s.

Stormraider's Surge.wiki: Deal 25% of a champion's max HP within 3 s: +36% move speed (ranged) and 50% slow resist for 4 s. Cooldown 20 to 8.82 s.

Arcane Comet.wiki: Ability damage drops a comet: 15 to 110 (+10% bonus AD, +5% AP), up to 30 to 220 at max travel distance. Cooldown 20 to 6.6 s.

Deathfire Touch.wiki: Ability damage burns: 1.5 to 6.53 (+3.5% bonus AD, +1.25% AP) magic every 0.5 s, 4 s from single-target spells, 2 s from area spells; +75% after 3 s.

Presence of Mind.wiki: Hitting a champion restores 4.8 to 44.8 mana (8 s cooldown). Takedown: 15% max mana.

Triumph.wiki: Takedown: heal 2.5% max HP + 5% missing HP, +20 gold.

Legend: Alacrity.wiki: 3% attack speed, +1.5% per Legend stack, up to 18% at 10 stacks.

Coup de Grace.wiki: 8% more damage to champions below 40% HP.

Cut Down.wiki: 8% more damage to champions above 60% HP.

Manaflow Band.wiki: Ability damage on a champion: +25 max mana (15 s cooldown), up to +250. Then restore 1% missing mana every 5 s.

Transcendence.wiki: Level 5 and 8: +5 ability haste each. Level 11: takedowns cut basic ability cooldowns by 20%.

Celerity.wiki: Move speed bonuses 7% stronger, +1% move speed.

Scorch.wiki: Ability damage sets the champion on fire: 20 to 42.35 magic after 1 s. Cooldown 10 s.

Magical Footwear.wiki: Free boots at 12 min (45 s sooner per takedown).

Cash Back.wiki: Refund 7.5% of each legendary item's cost.

Triple Tonic.wiki: Free elixirs at levels 3, 6 and 9 (Avarice, Force, Skill).

Approach Velocity.wiki: 7.5% move speed toward slowed or immobilised enemy champions you face.

Cheap Shot.wiki: Damage to a slowed or impaired champion: +10 to 49 true damage. Cooldown 4 s. Kog's E slows.

Treasure Hunter.wiki: 50 gold (+20 per stack) per unique takedown, up to 450.
